\item \textit{Notes:} Panel~A estimates the difference between the two members of each exclusive pair as a single outcome, so the standard error accounts for their covariance; comparing the separate ATTs in Table~1 in the main text by their significance stars does not test their difference. The EU-internal outcome in Table~1 in the main text counts a collaboration only if every participant is headquartered in the EU, so a collaboration between a German, a French and an American firm is classified as international; roughly a third of collaborations spanning two or more member states fall into that case. The broader outcome instead counts a collaboration whenever the firm has a partner in another member state, whether or not a non-EU participant is also present.
